arabic text: NAUHAA KUNAA HAI ZAINAB-E MUZTAR ALI KE BAAD\nKOHRAAM HAI MACHAA HUWAA GHAR GHAR ALI KE\nBAAD
english translation text: The grief-stricken Zainab laments after\nAli. Every home is filled\nwith uproar after Ali.

arabic text: MEHRAAB GHAMZADAA HAI NAMAAZI KIDHAR GAYAA\nWIRAAN HAI RASOOL KAA MIMBAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: The prayer niche mourns: where has its worshipper gone?\nThe Prophet’s pulpit lies desolate after Ali.

arabic text: MANZAR UBHAR KE AAGAYAA BAAZAARE SHAAM KAA\nZAINAB KE SAR SE JAB GIRI CHAADAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: The scene of Shaam’s marketplace rose before her eyes\nwhen Zainab’s veil fell from her head after Ali.

arabic text: SHEHZAADI BAN KE AAYI THI KUFE ME KAL YEHI\nDAR DAR PHIRI HAI ZAINAB-E MUZTAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: Only yesterday she entered Kufa as a princess;\nnow the grieving Zainab is driven from door to door after Ali.

arabic text: JO SAR THAA BOSAGAAHE ALI-O MUHAMMADI\nNEZE PE CHAD GAYAA HAI WOHI SAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: The head once kissed by Ali and Muhammad\nis now raised upon a spear after Ali.

arabic text: KUCHH KHUN MURTAZAA KI HAI KUCHH KARBALAA KI\nHAI\nSURKHI JO CHHAAGAYI HAI FALAK PAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: Some of that redness is Murtaza’s blood,\nand some is Karbala’s— the crimson\nspread across the sky after Ali.

arabic text: ASGHAR SAA NAUNEHAAL BHI KHUN ME NAHAA GAYAA\nUJDAA HAI IS TARHAA SE BHARAA GHAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: Even an infant like Asghar was bathed in blood.\nA once-full household was destroyed after Ali.

arabic text: DEKHO SITAM ZAMAANE KAA ZINDAANE SHAAM KAA\nROTE RAHE HAIN AALE PAYAAMBAR ALI KE BAAD
english translation text: Behold the cruelty of time and the prison of Shaam;\nthe Prophet’s family continued to weep after Ali.
